question.text: In the PM's dealing room, mobile phones and external communication devices:

answer.text: Are NOT allowed; only dedicated recorded lines and authorized emails
Are allowed only for senior staff

explanation.text: The Logic: Pages 106-107 require recorded telephone lines and authorized emails in the dealing room and ban mobile or other communication devices. The Trap: No time-of-day or seniority exception appears in the source. Note: Source-backed by NISM-XXI-A pages 106-107.
